answer.narration: You sit on a hard bench in the hall and fill in the claim form line by line: name, license number, the tug, the hold code. The clerk at the window stamps it without looking up. "Filed. Don't call us." Behind you, the courier job is still flickering on the screen.
choices: Ask about the short-hop courier job
Head to Marta's lot for advice
Ask Hale about the refugees' fate
answer.summary: Waren Spacefarer is a young pilot with ten credits who wants forty thousand to buy Marta Okafor's Kestrel. His relief pilot job on Dren Vasko's tug Grubstake turned out to be people smuggling. He warned customs, killed the drive, talked Vasko into surrendering and opened the hold to eleven refugees. After clumsily asking about a reward, he gave Inspector Hale an honest statement and filed an informant fund claim, now stamped and filed; payout is months away. A customs medic strapped his cracked ribs. The Vesta job is probably lost. A short-hop courier job paying cash on landing is on the customs job screen.
